description.value: Maria's Taverna is a Kitsilano institution on West 4th Avenue, serving authentic Greek cuisine since 1987 with recipes brought directly from Greece. The menu is anchored by mezze plates, lamb chops, souvlaki, moussaka, and fresh seafood, backed by a full bar featuring Greek imports and BC craft beers. Now under new management but keeping the original recipes, the welcoming dining room seats up to 80 and has drawn loyal regulars for nearly four decades.
